claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these rollers as easy to use and secure, holding hair in place well.
Many customers are happy to find these snap-on rollers since they are hard to find in stores.
Several reviewers note the rollers are gentle and do not pull or tangle hair.
Some reviewers complain the rollers are too small and can get stuck or tangled in hair, with a few reporting hair had to be cut out.
A few reviewers mention the rollers are expensive or wear out after a few uses.
